title: ShadowPKG theme manifest
description: A ShadowPKG theme manifest: the content of <id>.json (a single-file theme) or of theme.json (a folder theme). Unknown top-level keys and unknown palette keys are allowed: the server ignores them with a warning. null for an optional field means the same as leaving it out; write it out instead. What this schema cannot check, and the server does: (1) a key given twice in one object (a JSON parser keeps the last; the server refuses the file) and nesting deeper than 64 levels; (2) anything about the files of a folder theme: that assets/<file> exists, that its bytes are the type its name says, that an SVG has no script or outside link, the 1.5 MiB / 4 MiB / 24 file limits, and duplicate asset names that differ only in capitals; (3) the decoded size of a data: URL (300 KB for a picture, 900 KB for a font), that its base64 is valid (length a multiple of 4) and that the bytes are really that type; (4) the css text beyond its characters: at-rules, nested rules, brace balance, selectors, property names, the allowed function list, what may stand in a value, the string rules, and the 200 rule / 40 declaration limits (the schema only refuses < and control characters, and caps the length at 61440 characters where the server caps 60 KB of bytes, so css with multi-byte characters can pass the schema and fail the server); (5) lengths are counted by the server after it trims the text and collapses runs of white space, and by this schema on the text as written; a 300-character token value or a 40-character name that only fits after trimming can differ; (6) the size of the finished single file (1 MiB, measured on the cleaned, pretty-printed manifest), whether the id is already used, and the 64 theme limit; (7) lone surrogate characters in text, which the server refuses; (8) that css produces at least one rule (a css string of only comments does not count as content for the server; the schema counts any css with a non-space character); (9) which of the two forms a manifest is for: the root of this schema accepts assets/<file> (folder themes), and #/$defs/singleFile refuses it (single files); an asset name that is exactly an extension with no dot (a file called svg) is accepted by the server as a picture and refused here; (10) additionalProperties choices: unknown top-level keys and unknown palette keys are allowed because the server ignores them with a warning; unknown keys in a font entry are allowed because the server ignores them silently; unknown token names are refused because the server refuses them.

shadowtheme.description: The format version: the number 1. Required.

id.description: Optional in a file: the default is the file name without .json (or the folder name), made into a slug; a manifest sent to the server without one gets a slug of its name. 1 to 32 lower-case letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter or digit. Not the id of a built-in theme (ps1, ps1v2, midnight, purple, nes, snes, dreamcast, wii, itsmemario, yoshisisland, oled, nathan, win95, spookemon) and not a name Windows reserves for devices (con, prn, aux, nul, com1-com9, lpt1-lpt9).

name.description: Required. What the picker shows. 1 to 40 characters, not all white space, no < or > and no control characters.

author.description: Optional, at most 40 characters, same character rule as name.

description.description: Optional, at most 140 characters, same character rule as name.

version.description: Optional, at most 16 characters, same character rule as name. Shown only; nothing compares versions.

base.description: Optional, one of the fourteen built-in ids: which built-in look supplies the structure (fonts, bevels, scanlines, glows, shapes). Default midnight.

mode.description: Optional. Default: dark when the luminance of palette.background is below 0.4, else light (with no palette.background: light for base wii, dark for every other base). Picks shadow, backdrop and which side of the mid-tones the page colours are moved to.

palette.description: The colours the theme is derived from. Nothing in it is required: a missing colour comes from the base look's own seeds. background, surface, text and accent are the four seeds; the rest are optional. Keys the format does not know are ignored with a warning. surface2 is accepted but the current page ignores it. Values are text (or null, meaning left out), never alpha colours.

tokens.description: Explicit overrides, applied after the derivation and not corrected for readability (the runtime guard may still nudge text to 4.5:1). Each key must be one of the 51 tokens; an unknown key is an error. Each value must fit the token's type.

fonts.description: Up to 4 fonts, each declared here and then used by name in --font or in css.

family.description: The font-family name: a letter, then up to 39 letters, digits, spaces, . - and _. Not PixelChrome, a generic family name, or inherit, initial, unset, default (in any capitals).

weight.description: 100 to 900 in hundreds (as text or a number), normal or bold. Default 400.

items.description: A font entry. Keys other than family, src and weight are ignored by the server without a warning.

css.description: Extra plain rules, scoped by the server to this theme (every selector is prefixed with html[data-custom="<id>"]). At most 60 KB (in bytes), 200 rules, 40 declarations a rule; no at-rules, no nesting, no <, only the allowed functions; url() only of a data: picture or assets/<file>. A folder theme's theme.css is added after it. The schema checks only the characters.

logo.description: Optional, folder themes only. One assets/<file> picture shown in the header in place of the built-in glyph; the wordmark text is hidden. The server checks the file exists and, for SVG, that it is plain shapes.

icons.description: Optional, folder themes only. A map of icon kind to assets/<file> picture overriding the built-in row icon for that kind. Kinds: file, document, text, image, video, audio, archive, disk, code, package, folder. Unknown kinds are ignored with a warning.

colourPalette.description: A palette colour: #rgb, #rrggbb, rgb(), rgba(), hsl() or hsla() with three plain numbers (comma or space form; % where CSS allows). No alpha part, no transparent, no names, no var(). The server stores it as lower-case #rrggbb.

colour.description: A colour token value: #rgb #rgba #rrggbb #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() with plain numbers (comma form, or space form with an optional / alpha; % where CSS allows), or transparent. No colour names, var() or currentColor.

paint.description: A colour or a gradient: linear-gradient( [Ndeg | to <side> [<side>],] 2 to 6 stops ) or radial-gradient( [circle|ellipse [at <pos> [<pos>]] | at <pos> [<pos>],] 2 to 6 stops ). A stop is a colour with an optional length or percentage.

image.description: none, or 1 to 3 comma-separated layers, each a gradient or url() of a data:image/(png|jpeg|webp|gif|svg+xml);base64 picture or of assets/<file> (folder themes only). 300 characters, not counting embedded picture data (which has its own 300 KB limit that a pattern cannot check).

shadow.description: none, or 1 to 4 comma-separated shadows: [inset] x y [blur [spread]] colour, lengths in px (0 needs no unit), the blur not negative.

length.description: 0, or a number with px (at most 64), rem or em (at most 4). Lower-case units.

font.description: 1 to 8 comma-separated families: a bare name of letters, digits, spaces, - and _ (starting with a letter; the generic names are bare names), or a "quoted" or 'quoted' name of up to 64 letters, digits, spaces, . - and _. At most 200 characters.

fontSrc.description: data:font/(woff2|woff|ttf|otf);base64,<data> (900 KB decoded at most, checked by the server), or assets/<file> with a .woff2, .woff, .ttf or .otf name (folder themes only). No white space is trimmed.

singleFile.description: A manifest for a single <id>.json: the same as the root, and no assets/<file> reference anywhere (tokens, fonts, css): a single file cannot use asset files.
